Title: Public preview: Azure Monitor Scheduled Query Rules API 2021-02-01-preview

Body.Content:
We’ve recently released Scheduled Query Rules API version 2021-02-01-preview in Azure Monitor. This version is the latest iteration of the new log alerts experience and includes the following updates:

  • Automatically resolving alert rules are now enabled by default.
  • You can define linked storage as a policy and force check of linked storage in the API (enabling CMK enforcement).
  • Enabled webhooks properties.
  • Simplified the action groups definition in actions section.

We recommend you make the switch early to take advantage of the above benefits. With this new API version 2021-02-01-preview, we’ll be retiring and removing the previous iteration of Scheduled Query Rules preview version 2020-05-01-preview on 31 October 2021.

To avoid service disruption, update any Azure Resource Manager templates that use the Microsoft.Insights/ScheduledQueryRules resource provider to use 2021-02-01 API version by 31 October 2021. 

Learn more and see template samples.
